props.animation_script:
// @desc Geist — Dark Bane: melee rush, purple slash on target, dash back (oni)

"use strict";

(async () => {

const CFG = {

slashWebm: "modules/JB2A_DnD5e/Library/Generic/Weapon_Attacks/Melee/Group01/TrailAttack01_01_02_Regular_PinkPurple_800x600.webm",

slashSize: 420,

hitSfx: "https://assets.forge-vtt.com/610d918102e7ac281373ffcb/Sound/Hit_PiercingB.ogg",

volume: 0.5,

lungeMs: 240, // caster -> target dash

backMs: 300, // dash home

standoff: 0.62, // stop this fraction of the way (don't overlap the target)

impactParticles: 14,

particleColor: "rgba(190,90,255,0.95)",

particleSpread: 130,

particleMs: 460,

shakeMs: 300,

shakeIntensity: 7,

};

const P = payload ?? globalThis.__PAYLOAD ?? {};

const casterUuid = P.casterTokenUuid ?? P.sourceTokenUuid ?? null;

const targetUuids = (P.targetTokenUuids ?? (P.targets ?? []).map((t) => t.tokenUuid) ?? []).filter(Boolean);

const doneHook = "oni:done:" + foundry.utils.randomID(8);

const onceHook = (name, ms) => new Promise((resolve) => {

const id = Hooks.once(name, () => { clearTimeout(t); resolve(); });

const t = setTimeout(() => { Hooks.off(name, id); resolve(); }, ms);

});

Hooks.callAll("oni:animationStart", { local: true, world: false });

const scriptSource = String.raw`

const cfg = ctx.params.cfg;

const caster = oni.caster;

const target = oni.targets[0] || null;

if (!caster || !target) { oni.fireDone(); return; }

const layer = oni.layer({ zIndex: 96000 });

// Load a webm as a VALID video texture (Foundry loadTexture; PIXI.Texture.from

// leaves video textures invalid/invisible in this build).

const playWebm = async (url, size, x, y, z) => {

let tex; try { tex = await loadTexture(url); } catch (e) { return null; }

if (!tex) return null;

const spr = new PIXI.Sprite(tex); spr.anchor.set(0.5);

spr.width = spr.height = size; spr.position.set(x, y); spr.zIndex = z || 96500;

layer.addChild(spr);

const v = tex.baseTexture && tex.baseTexture.resource && tex.baseTexture.resource.source;

if (v && v.tagName === 'VIDEO') { try { v.loop = false; v.muted = true; v.currentTime = 0; v.play && v.play().catch(() => {}); } catch (e) {} }

return { sprite: spr, video: v };

};

const cx = caster.center.x, cy = caster.center.y;

const tx = target.center.x, ty = target.center.y;

const hx = cx + (tx - cx) * cfg.standoff;

const hy = cy + (ty - cy) * cfg.standoff;

// Clone Geist and hide the real token so the clone does the rushing.

const clone = oni.cloneToken(caster, { parent: layer });

const restore = oni.hideToken(caster);

// Rush in.

await oni.tween({

duration: cfg.lungeMs, ease: oni.EASE.inCubic,

onUpdate: (v) => clone && clone.position.set(cx + (hx - cx) * v, cy + (hy - cy) * v),

});

// Impact: purple slash webm on the target + particle burst + shake + sfx.

await playWebm(cfg.slashWebm, cfg.slashSize, tx, ty, 96500);

const parts = [];

for (let i = 0; i < cfg.impactParticles; i++) {

const pt = new PIXI.Sprite(oni.radialTexture(cfg.particleColor, 'rgba(0,0,0,0)', { size: 64 }));

pt.anchor.set(0.5);

pt.blendMode = PIXI.BLEND_MODES.ADD;

pt.width = pt.height = 10 + Math.random() * 22;

pt.position.set(tx, ty);

const ang = Math.random() * Math.PI * 2;

const dist = cfg.particleSpread * (0.4 + Math.random() * 0.6);

pt._dx = Math.cos(ang) * dist; pt._dy = Math.sin(ang) * dist;

layer.addChild(pt);

parts.push(pt);

}

oni.sfx(cfg.hitSfx, { volume: cfg.volume });

oni.screenshake({ duration: cfg.shakeMs, intensity: cfg.shakeIntensity });

await oni.tween({

from: 0, to: 1, duration: cfg.particleMs, ease: oni.EASE.outCubic,

onUpdate: (v) => {

for (const pt of parts) {

pt.position.set(tx + pt._dx * v, ty + pt._dy * v);

pt.alpha = 1 - v;

}

},

});

// Dash home + restore the real token.

await oni.tween({

duration: cfg.backMs, ease: oni.EASE.outQuad,

onUpdate: (v) => clone && clone.position.set(hx + (cx - hx) * v, hy + (cy - hy) * v),

});

restore();

// Fire the damage gate AFTER the full attack plays. BD's RESOLVE (CSB HP

// recompute) briefly stalls the frame; gating at the end keeps that pause

// out of the choreography so the motion never looks frozen mid-sequence.

oni.fireDone();

`;

game.ONI.pseudo.play({

scriptId: "geist/dark-bane",

scriptSource,

casterTokenUuid: casterUuid,

targetTokenUuids: targetUuids,

params: { doneHook, cfg: CFG },

});

await onceHook(doneHook, CFG.lungeMs + CFG.particleMs + CFG.backMs + 6000);

Hooks.callAll("oni:animationEnd", { local: true, world: false });

})();

props.animation_script:
// @desc Geist — Dark Missionary: sacrifice, 3 Dark Souls rise at EXACT spawn cells, camera focus (oni)

"use strict";

(async () => {

const CFG = {

// Geist Sacrifice HP (shared beat)

sacWebm: "modules/JB2A_DnD5e/Library/Cantrip/Toll_The_Dead/TollTheDeadSkullSmoke_01_Regular_Green_400x400.webm",

sacSfx: "https://assets.forge-vtt.com/610d918102e7ac281373ffcb/Sound/Blind.ogg",

sacSize: 260, sacRise: 0.55, sacHold: 620, sacVol: 0.85,

// Souls (NO screen dim for this move)

spawnSfx: "https://assets.forge-vtt.com/610d918102e7ac281373ffcb/Sound/Spook.mp3",

volume: 0.85,

soulCount: 3,

riseMs: 1150, // per-soul rise duration

staggerMs: 300, // delay between successive souls

shadeColor: "rgba(16,4,32,0.96)",

rimColor: "rgba(150,70,240,0.9)",

shadeWCells: 0.78,

shadeHCells: 1.25,

poolWCells: 1.05,

riseMotesPer: 8,

settleMs: 360,

// Camera focus on the spawn area during the sequence

camZoom: 1.12,

camPanMs: 520,

camResetMs: 520,

};

const P = payload ?? globalThis.__PAYLOAD ?? {};

const casterUuid = P.casterTokenUuid ?? P.sourceTokenUuid ?? null;

const doneHook = "oni:done:" + foundry.utils.randomID(8);

const onceHook = (name, ms) => new Promise((resolve) => {

const id = Hooks.once(name, () => { clearTimeout(t); resolve(); });

const t = setTimeout(() => { Hooks.off(name, id); resolve(); }, ms);

});

Hooks.callAll("oni:animationStart", { local: true, world: false });

const scriptSource = String.raw`

const cfg = ctx.params.cfg;

const caster = oni.caster;

if (!caster) { oni.fireDone(); return; }

const layer = oni.layer({ zIndex: 96000 });

const cx = caster.center.x, cy = caster.center.y;

const th = (caster.h ?? caster.mesh?.height ?? 100);

// Valid video-texture loader (PIXI.Texture.from leaves webms invisible here).

const playWebm = async (url, size, x, y, z) => {

let tex; try { tex = await loadTexture(url); } catch (e) { return null; }

if (!tex) return null;

const spr = new PIXI.Sprite(tex); spr.anchor.set(0.5);

spr.width = spr.height = size; spr.position.set(x, y); spr.zIndex = z || 96500;

layer.addChild(spr);

const v = tex.baseTexture && tex.baseTexture.resource && tex.baseTexture.resource.source;

if (v && v.tagName === 'VIDEO') { try { v.loop = false; v.muted = true; v.currentTime = 0; v.play && v.play().catch(() => {}); } catch (e) {} }

return { sprite: spr, video: v };

};

// EXACT spawn placement — replicates director-init.spawnLiveDirectorTokens so

// each rise lands on a real Dark Soul cell (down-column fill from the anchor).

const computeSpawnCells = (count) => {

const scene = canvas.scene;

const grid = canvas.grid?.size ?? 100;

const SW = scene?.width ?? (canvas.dimensions?.sceneWidth ?? 0);

const SH = scene?.height ?? (canvas.dimensions?.sceneHeight ?? 0);

const step = grid * 1.15;

const toward = (SW / 2 >= cx) ? 1 : -1;

const anchorX = cx + toward * grid * 1.15;

const baseX = Math.round(anchorX), baseY = Math.round(cy);

const dir = anchorX <= SW / 2 ? 1 : -1;

const occupied = ((scene && scene.tokens && scene.tokens.contents) ? scene.tokens.contents : [])

.map((t) => ({ x: t.x + ((t.width || 1) * grid) / 2, y: t.y + ((t.height || 1) * grid) / 2 }));

const freeCell = () => {

for (let col = 0; col < 5; col++) for (let row = 0; row < 8; row++) {

const x = baseX + col * step * dir;

const y = baseY + row * step;

if (x < grid || x > SW - grid || y > SH - grid) continue;

if (occupied.some((o) => Math.abs(o.x - x) < grid * 0.7 && Math.abs(o.y - y) < grid * 0.7)) continue;

return { x, y };

}

return { x: baseX, y: Math.min(SH - grid, baseY) };

};

const cells = [];

for (let i = 0; i < count; i++) { const c = freeCell(); occupied.push(c); cells.push(c); }

return { cells, grid };

};

// ── Geist Sacrifice HP ──

oni.sfx(cfg.sacSfx, { volume: cfg.sacVol });

await playWebm(cfg.sacWebm, cfg.sacSize, cx, cy - th * cfg.sacRise, 96800);

await oni.wait(cfg.sacHold);

const n = Math.max(1, cfg.soulCount);

const { cells, grid } = computeSpawnCells(n);

// Build one rising "soul" at a cell centre.

function makeSoul(ax, ay) {

const pool = new PIXI.Sprite(oni.radialTexture(cfg.shadeColor, 'rgba(0,0,0,0)', { size: 256 }));

pool.anchor.set(0.5); pool.position.set(ax, ay + grid * 0.45); pool.width = pool.height = 0;

layer.addChild(pool);

const rim = new PIXI.Sprite(oni.radialTexture(cfg.rimColor, 'rgba(0,0,0,0)', { size: 256 }));

rim.anchor.set(0.5, 1.0); rim.blendMode = PIXI.BLEND_MODES.ADD;

rim.position.set(ax, ay + grid * 0.5); rim.width = grid * cfg.shadeWCells * 1.2; rim.height = 0; rim.alpha = 0;

layer.addChild(rim);

const shade = new PIXI.Sprite(oni.radialTexture(cfg.shadeColor, 'rgba(0,0,0,0)', { size: 256 }));

shade.anchor.set(0.5, 1.0); shade.position.set(ax, ay + grid * 0.5);

shade.width = grid * cfg.shadeWCells; shade.height = 0;

layer.addChild(shade);

const motes = [];

for (let i = 0; i < cfg.riseMotesPer; i++) {

const m = new PIXI.Sprite(oni.radialTexture(cfg.rimColor, 'rgba(0,0,0,0)', { size: 48 }));

m.anchor.set(0.5); m.blendMode = PIXI.BLEND_MODES.ADD;

m.width = m.height = 7 + Math.random() * 13;

m._x = ax + (Math.random() - 0.5) * grid * cfg.shadeWCells;

m._y0 = ay + grid * 0.4; m._h = grid * cfg.shadeHCells * (0.5 + Math.random() * 0.6);

m._delay = Math.random() * 0.5;

m.position.set(m._x, m._y0); m.alpha = 0;

layer.addChild(m); motes.push(m);

}

return { pool, rim, shade, motes };

}

const souls = cells.map((c) => makeSoul(c.x, c.y));

// Camera focus on the spawn cells, restored in finally.

const cam0 = { x: canvas.stage.pivot.x, y: canvas.stage.pivot.y, scale: canvas.stage.scale.x };

let fx = 0, fy = 0; for (const c of cells) { fx += c.x; fy += c.y; } fx /= cells.length; fy /= cells.length;

try {

await canvas.animatePan({ x: fx, y: fy, scale: cam0.scale * cfg.camZoom, duration: cfg.camPanMs });

// One SFX for the whole move.

oni.sfx(cfg.spawnSfx, { volume: cfg.volume });

const total = cfg.riseMs + cfg.staggerMs * (n - 1);

let fired = false;

await oni.tween({

from: 0, to: 1, duration: total, ease: oni.EASE.linear,

onUpdate: (g) => {

const elapsed = g * total;

for (let i = 0; i < souls.length; i++) {

const s = souls[i];

const local = Math.max(0, Math.min(1, (elapsed - i * cfg.staggerMs) / cfg.riseMs));

const v = oni.EASE.outCubic(local);

s.pool.width = grid * cfg.poolWCells * Math.min(1, v * 1.6);

s.pool.height = grid * cfg.poolWCells * 0.42 * Math.min(1, v * 1.6);

s.pool.alpha = Math.min(1, v * 2);

s.shade.height = grid * cfg.shadeHCells * v;

s.rim.height = grid * cfg.shadeHCells * v; s.rim.alpha = Math.sin(v * Math.PI) * 0.55;

for (const m of s.motes) {

const t = Math.max(0, (v - m._delay) / (1 - m._delay));

m.position.set(m._x, m._y0 - m._h * t);

m.alpha = Math.sin(Math.min(1, t) * Math.PI) * 0.85;

}

}

if (!fired && g >= 0.85) { fired = true; oni.fireDone(); }

},

});

if (!fired) oni.fireDone();

// Settle out; the real summoned tokens take over these spots.

await oni.tween({

from: 1, to: 0, duration: cfg.settleMs, ease: oni.EASE.inQuad,

onUpdate: (v) => {

for (const s of souls) {

s.shade.alpha = v; s.pool.alpha = v; s.rim.alpha = v * 0.5;

for (const m of s.motes) m.alpha = v * 0.5;

}

},

});

} finally {

try { await canvas.animatePan({ x: cam0.x, y: cam0.y, scale: cam0.scale, duration: cfg.camResetMs }); } catch (e) {}

}

`;

game.ONI.pseudo.play({

scriptId: "geist/dark-missionary",

scriptSource,

casterTokenUuid: casterUuid,

targetTokenUuids: [],

params: { doneHook, cfg: CFG },

});

await onceHook(doneHook, CFG.sacHold + CFG.camPanMs + CFG.riseMs + CFG.staggerMs * 2 + CFG.settleMs + CFG.camResetMs + 7000);

Hooks.callAll("oni:animationEnd", { local: true, world: false });

})();

// @desc Geist — Torcleaver: dash, side slash, crescent shockwave to target (oni)

"use strict";

(async () => {

const CFG = {

slashWebm: "modules/JB2A_DnD5e/Library/Generic/Weapon_Attacks/Melee/Group05/TrailAttack05_01_04_Regular_PinkPurple_800x600.webm",

slashSize: 460,

slashSideDist: 150, // how far to the side of the caster the slash plays

dashMs: 160, // quick forward dash

dashFrac: 0.22, // dash this fraction toward the target

homeMs: 300,

waveColor: 0xbe5aff,

waveHalfLen: 90, // half-length of the crescent (horn to horn)

waveBellyOut: 130, // outer (convex) bulge control — bigger = deeper moon

waveBellyIn: 54, // inner bulge control (shallower than outer -> crescent)

waveTravelMs: 360,

hitParticles: 14,

particleColor: "rgba(190,90,255,0.95)",

particleSpread: 130,

particleMs: 460,

shakeMs: 300,

shakeIntensity: 7,

volume: 0.85,

};

const P = payload ?? globalThis.__PAYLOAD ?? {};

const casterUuid = P.casterTokenUuid ?? P.sourceTokenUuid ?? null;

const targetUuids = (P.targetTokenUuids ?? (P.targets ?? []).map((t) => t.tokenUuid) ?? []).filter(Boolean);

const doneHook = "oni:done:" + foundry.utils.randomID(8);

const onceHook = (name, ms) => new Promise((resolve) => {

const id = Hooks.once(name, () => { clearTimeout(t); resolve(); });

const t = setTimeout(() => { Hooks.off(name, id); resolve(); }, ms);

});

Hooks.callAll("oni:animationStart", { local: true, world: false });

const scriptSource = String.raw`

const cfg = ctx.params.cfg;

const caster = oni.caster;

const target = oni.targets[0] || null;

if (!caster || !target) { oni.fireDone(); return; }

const layer = oni.layer({ zIndex: 96000 });

// Valid video-texture loader (PIXI.Texture.from leaves webms invisible here).

const playWebm = async (url, size, x, y, z) => {

let tex; try { tex = await loadTexture(url); } catch (e) { return null; }

if (!tex) return null;

const spr = new PIXI.Sprite(tex); spr.anchor.set(0.5);

spr.width = spr.height = size; spr.position.set(x, y); spr.zIndex = z || 96500;

layer.addChild(spr);

const v = tex.baseTexture && tex.baseTexture.resource && tex.baseTexture.resource.source;

if (v && v.tagName === 'VIDEO') { try { v.loop = false; v.muted = true; v.currentTime = 0; v.play && v.play().catch(() => {}); } catch (e) {} }

return { sprite: spr, video: v };

};

const cx = caster.center.x, cy = caster.center.y;

const tx = target.center.x, ty = target.center.y;

const dx = cx + (tx - cx) * cfg.dashFrac, dy = cy + (ty - cy) * cfg.dashFrac;

// Disposition-aware side: enemy (-1) -> screen right (+x); ally (+1) -> left (-x).

const disp = Number(caster.document?.disposition ?? -1);

const sideSign = disp === 1 ? -1 : 1;

// Quick forward dash (clone; real token hidden).

const clone = oni.cloneToken(caster, { parent: layer });

const restore = oni.hideToken(caster);

await oni.tween({

duration: cfg.dashMs, ease: oni.EASE.outCubic,

onUpdate: (v) => clone && clone.position.set(cx + (dx - cx) * v, cy + (dy - cy) * v),

});

// Slash flourish to the side of the caster.

await playWebm(cfg.slashWebm, cfg.slashSize, dx + sideSign * cfg.slashSideDist, dy, 96400);

// Crescent shockwave projectile: a filled lune with SHARP tapered horns

// (energy-slash look), not a blocky stroked arc. Two quadratic edges sharing

// both endpoints -> pointed tips; outer edge bulges more than the inner.

const ang = Math.atan2(ty - dy, tx - dx);

const drawCrescent = (g, L, hOut, hIn, color, alpha) => {

g.beginFill(color, alpha);

g.moveTo(-L, 0);

g.quadraticCurveTo(0, hOut, L, 0); // outer convex edge

g.quadraticCurveTo(0, hIn, -L, 0); // inner edge (shallower) -> crescent

g.endFill();

};

const wave = new PIXI.Graphics();

drawCrescent(wave, cfg.waveHalfLen, cfg.waveBellyOut, cfg.waveBellyIn, cfg.waveColor, 0.95);

const glow = new PIXI.Graphics();

drawCrescent(glow, cfg.waveHalfLen * 1.14, cfg.waveBellyOut * 1.2, cfg.waveBellyIn * 0.85, cfg.waveColor, 0.32);

wave.blendMode = PIXI.BLEND_MODES.ADD;

glow.blendMode = PIXI.BLEND_MODES.ADD;

const waveC = new PIXI.Container();

waveC.addChild(glow); waveC.addChild(wave);

waveC.rotation = ang - Math.PI / 2; // belly leads the travel direction (tunable)

waveC.position.set(dx, dy);

layer.addChild(waveC);

await oni.tween({

from: 0, to: 1, duration: cfg.waveTravelMs, ease: oni.EASE.inQuad,

onUpdate: (v) => {

waveC.position.set(dx + (tx - dx) * v, dy + (ty - dy) * v);

waveC.alpha = 1 - 0.3 * v;

},

});

// Impact: target shake (jitter clone) + particle burst + shake + gate.

const tClone = oni.cloneToken(target, { parent: layer });

const tRestore = oni.hideToken(target);

const parts = [];

for (let i = 0; i < cfg.hitParticles; i++) {

const pt = new PIXI.Sprite(oni.radialTexture(cfg.particleColor, 'rgba(0,0,0,0)', { size: 64 }));

pt.anchor.set(0.5);

pt.blendMode = PIXI.BLEND_MODES.ADD;

pt.width = pt.height = 10 + Math.random() * 22;

pt.position.set(tx, ty);

const a = Math.random() * Math.PI * 2;

const d = cfg.particleSpread * (0.4 + Math.random() * 0.6);

pt._dx = Math.cos(a) * d; pt._dy = Math.sin(a) * d;

layer.addChild(pt);

parts.push(pt);

}

waveC.destroy();

oni.screenshake({ duration: cfg.shakeMs, intensity: cfg.shakeIntensity });

await Promise.all([

oni.tween({

from: 0, to: 1, duration: cfg.particleMs, ease: oni.EASE.outCubic,

onUpdate: (v) => { for (const pt of parts) { pt.position.set(tx + pt._dx * v, ty + pt._dy * v); pt.alpha = 1 - v; } },

}),

oni.tween({

from: 0, to: 1, duration: cfg.shakeMs, ease: oni.EASE.linear,

onUpdate: (v) => { if (tClone) { const amp = 12 * (1 - v); tClone.position.set(tx + (Math.random() - 0.5) * 2 * amp, ty + (Math.random() - 0.5) * 2 * amp); } },

}),

]);

if (tClone) tClone.position.set(tx, ty);

tRestore();

// Dash home.

await oni.tween({

duration: cfg.homeMs, ease: oni.EASE.outQuad,

onUpdate: (v) => clone && clone.position.set(dx + (cx - dx) * v, dy + (cy - dy) * v),

});

restore();

// Gate damage AFTER the full attack (keeps BD's RESOLVE HP-recompute stall

// out of the choreography — see Dark Bane note).

oni.fireDone();

`;

game.ONI.pseudo.play({

scriptId: "geist/torcleaver",

scriptSource,

casterTokenUuid: casterUuid,

targetTokenUuids: targetUuids,

params: { doneHook, cfg: CFG },

});

await onceHook(doneHook, CFG.dashMs + CFG.waveTravelMs + CFG.particleMs + CFG.homeMs + 6000);

Hooks.callAll("oni:animationEnd", { local: true, world: false });

})();

const scriptSource = String.raw`

const cfg = ctx.params.cfg;

const caster = oni.caster;

if (!caster) { oni.fireDone(); return; }

const s = oni.screen();

const cx = caster.center.x, cy = caster.center.y;

const diag = Math.hypot(s.W, s.H);

const maxD = s.wLen(diag) * cfg.burstScreens;

const auraR = maxD * cfg.auraFrac * 0.5;

const dim = await oni.dim({ to: cfg.dimTo, fadeIn: cfg.dimInMs, zIndex: 80000 });

oni.sfx(cfg.sfx, { volume: cfg.volume });

const layer = oni.layer({ zIndex: 90000 });

// ── Charge: shimmer clone + tightening core ──

const shimmer = oni.cloneToken(caster, { parent: layer });

if (shimmer) { shimmer.blendMode = PIXI.BLEND_MODES.ADD; shimmer.tint = cfg.shimmerColor; shimmer.alpha = 0; }

const dark = new PIXI.Sprite(oni.radialTexture(cfg.darkColor, 'rgba(0,0,0,0)', { size: 256 }));

dark.anchor.set(0.5); dark.position.set(cx, cy); dark.width = dark.height = 0;

layer.addChild(dark);

const core = new PIXI.Sprite(oni.radialTexture(cfg.coreColor, 'rgba(0,0,0,0)', { size: 256 }));

core.anchor.set(0.5); core.blendMode = PIXI.BLEND_MODES.ADD; core.position.set(cx, cy); core.width = core.height = 0;

layer.addChild(core);

await oni.tween({

from: 0, to: 1, duration: cfg.chargeMs, ease: oni.EASE.inCubic,

onUpdate: (v) => { core.width = core.height = 150 * v; core.alpha = v; if (shimmer) shimmer.alpha = Math.sin(v * Math.PI) * cfg.shimmerAlpha; },

});

// ── Energy strands (built once, animated through burst + hold) ──

const strands = [];

for (let i = 0; i < cfg.strandCount; i++) {

const st = new PIXI.Sprite(oni.radialTexture(cfg.strandColor, 'rgba(0,0,0,0)', { size: 128 }));

st.anchor.set(0.5, 1.0); st.blendMode = PIXI.BLEND_MODES.ADD;

st.position.set(cx, cy);

st._ang = (i / cfg.strandCount) * Math.PI * 2 + Math.random() * 0.2;

st.rotation = st._ang + Math.PI / 2;

st._phase = Math.random();

st.width = cfg.strandWidth * (0.7 + Math.random() * 0.6);

st.height = 0;

layer.addChild(st); strands.push(st);

}

// ── Particle stream pool (continuous emission during the hold) ──

const parts = [];

for (let i = 0; i < cfg.particleCount; i++) {

const m = new PIXI.Sprite(oni.radialTexture(cfg.particleColor, 'rgba(0,0,0,0)', { size: 48 }));

m.anchor.set(0.5); m.blendMode = PIXI.BLEND_MODES.ADD;

m._sz = 10 + Math.random() * 20;

m.width = m.height = m._sz;

m._ang = Math.random() * Math.PI * 2;

m._phase = Math.random();

m._dist = auraR * (0.7 + Math.random() * 0.7);

m.position.set(cx, cy); m.alpha = 0;

layer.addChild(m); parts.push(m);

}

// ── BURST: energy erupts outward; core flashes toward screen-cover ──

oni.screenshake({ duration: cfg.burstMs, intensity: cfg.burstShake });

let fired = false;

await oni.tween({

from: 0, to: 1, duration: cfg.burstMs, ease: oni.EASE.outCubic,

onUpdate: (v) => {

core.width = core.height = maxD * v; core.alpha = 0.55 + 0.45 * v;

dark.width = dark.height = maxD * 0.8 * v; dark.alpha = 0.5 * v;

for (const st of strands) { st.height = auraR * cfg.strandLenFrac * v; st.alpha = v; }

for (const m of parts) { const t = v; m.position.set(cx + Math.cos(m._ang) * m._dist * t, cy + Math.sin(m._ang) * m._dist * t); m.alpha = v * 0.9; }

if (!fired && v >= 0.7) { fired = true; oni.fireDone(); }

},

});

if (!fired) oni.fireDone();

// ── HOLD (3s): living aura — core breathes, strands pulse, particles stream ──

oni.screenshake({ duration: cfg.holdMs, intensity: cfg.holdShake });

await oni.tween({

from: 0, to: 1, duration: cfg.holdMs, ease: oni.EASE.linear,

onUpdate: (g) => {

const breathe = 0.5 + 0.5 * Math.sin(g * cfg.auraPulses * Math.PI * 2);

core.width = core.height = auraR * 2 * (0.9 + 0.18 * breathe);

core.alpha = 0.7 + 0.25 * breathe;

dark.width = dark.height = auraR * 2 * 1.1;

dark.alpha = 0.45 + 0.15 * breathe;

if (shimmer) shimmer.alpha = (0.35 + 0.35 * breathe) * cfg.shimmerAlpha;

for (const st of strands) {

const p = 0.5 + 0.5 * Math.sin((g * cfg.strandPulses + st._phase) * Math.PI * 2);

st.height = auraR * cfg.strandLenFrac * (0.45 + 0.9 * p);

st.alpha = 0.35 + 0.6 * p;

}

for (const m of parts) {

const ph = (g * cfg.particleCycles + m._phase) % 1;

m.position.set(cx + Math.cos(m._ang) * m._dist * ph, cy + Math.sin(m._ang) * m._dist * ph);

m.width = m.height = m._sz * (1 - 0.4 * ph);

m.alpha = Math.sin(ph * Math.PI) * 0.9;

}

},

});

// ── Cleanup: collapse aura + undim ──

await oni.tween({

from: 1, to: 0, duration: cfg.cleanupMs, ease: oni.EASE.inQuad,

onUpdate: (v) => {

core.alpha = v * 0.9; dark.alpha = v * 0.5;

for (const st of strands) st.alpha = v * 0.6;

for (const m of parts) m.alpha = v * 0.5;

if (shimmer) shimmer.alpha = v * cfg.shimmerAlpha * 0.4;

},

});

await dim.fadeOut({ duration: 340 });

`;

game.ONI.pseudo.play({

scriptId: "geist/shadowbringers",

scriptSource,

casterTokenUuid: casterUuid,

targetTokenUuids: [],

params: { doneHook, cfg: CFG },

});

await onceHook(doneHook, CFG.dimInMs + CFG.chargeMs + CFG.burstMs + CFG.holdMs + CFG.cleanupMs + 6000);

Hooks.callAll("oni:animationEnd", { local: true, world: false });

})();

"use strict";

(async () => {

// Geist Sacrifice HP (shared beat)

sacWebm: "modules/JB2A_DnD5e/Library/Cantrip/Toll_The_Dead/TollTheDeadSkullSmoke_01_Regular_Green_400x400.webm",

sacSfx: "https://assets.forge-vtt.com/610d918102e7ac281373ffcb/Sound/Blind.ogg",

sacSize: 260, sacRise: 0.55, sacHold: 620, sacVol: 0.85,

riseSfx: "https://assets.forge-vtt.com/610d918102e7ac281373ffcb/Sound/Soundboard/Darkness1.ogg",

volume: 0.85,

riseMs: 1450, // slow, ominous

shadeColor: "rgba(18,4,34,0.96)",

rimColor: "rgba(150,70,240,0.9)",

shadeWCells: 0.95,

shadeHCells: 1.65,

poolWCells: 1.3,

riseMotes: 16,

settleMs: 380,

};

const P = payload ?? globalThis.__PAYLOAD ?? {};

const casterUuid = P.casterTokenUuid ?? P.sourceTokenUuid ?? null;

const doneHook = "oni:done:" + foundry.utils.randomID(8);

const onceHook = (name, ms) => new Promise((resolve) => {

const scriptSource = String.raw`

const cfg = ctx.params.cfg;

const caster = oni.caster;

if (!caster) { oni.fireDone(); return; }

const layer = oni.layer({ zIndex: 96000 });

const cx = caster.center.x, cy = caster.center.y;

const th = (caster.h ?? caster.mesh?.height ?? 100);

// Valid video-texture loader (PIXI.Texture.from leaves webms invisible here).

const playWebm = async (url, size, x, y, z) => {

let tex; try { tex = await loadTexture(url); } catch (e) { return null; }

if (!tex) return null;

const spr = new PIXI.Sprite(tex); spr.anchor.set(0.5);

spr.width = spr.height = size; spr.position.set(x, y); spr.zIndex = z || 96500;

layer.addChild(spr);

const v = tex.baseTexture && tex.baseTexture.resource && tex.baseTexture.resource.source;

if (v && v.tagName === 'VIDEO') { try { v.loop = false; v.muted = true; v.currentTime = 0; v.play && v.play().catch(() => {}); } catch (e) {} }

return { sprite: spr, video: v };

};

// EXACT spawn placement — replicates director-init.spawnLiveDirectorTokens so

// the rise lands on the real summon cell. applySummonEffect anchors one cell

// ahead of the caster toward scene centre; freeCell then fills down-column.

const computeSpawnCells = (count) => {

const scene = canvas.scene;

const grid = canvas.grid?.size ?? 100;

const SW = scene?.width ?? (canvas.dimensions?.sceneWidth ?? 0);

const SH = scene?.height ?? (canvas.dimensions?.sceneHeight ?? 0);

const step = grid * 1.15;

const toward = (SW / 2 >= cx) ? 1 : -1;

const anchorX = cx + toward * grid * 1.15;

const baseX = Math.round(anchorX), baseY = Math.round(cy);

const dir = anchorX <= SW / 2 ? 1 : -1;

const occupied = ((scene && scene.tokens && scene.tokens.contents) ? scene.tokens.contents : [])

.map((t) => ({ x: t.x + ((t.width || 1) * grid) / 2, y: t.y + ((t.height || 1) * grid) / 2 }));

const freeCell = () => {

for (let col = 0; col < 5; col++) for (let row = 0; row < 8; row++) {

const x = baseX + col * step * dir;

const y = baseY + row * step;

if (x < grid || x > SW - grid || y > SH - grid) continue;

if (occupied.some((o) => Math.abs(o.x - x) < grid * 0.7 && Math.abs(o.y - y) < grid * 0.7)) continue;

return { x, y };

}

return { x: baseX, y: Math.min(SH - grid, baseY) };

};

const cells = [];

for (let i = 0; i < count; i++) { const c = freeCell(); occupied.push(c); cells.push(c); }

return { cells, grid };

};

// ── Geist Sacrifice HP ──

oni.sfx(cfg.sacSfx, { volume: cfg.sacVol });

await playWebm(cfg.sacWebm, cfg.sacSize, cx, cy - th * cfg.sacRise, 96800);

await oni.wait(cfg.sacHold);

// ── Dim ──

const dim = await oni.dim({ to: cfg.dimTo, fadeIn: cfg.dimInMs, zIndex: 80000 });

// Real spawn cell (token CENTER).

const { cells, grid } = computeSpawnCells(1);

const ax = cells[0].x, ay = cells[0].y;

// Ground pool + rising shade (bottom-anchored so it grows upward).

const pool = new PIXI.Sprite(oni.radialTexture(cfg.shadeColor, 'rgba(0,0,0,0)', { size: 256 }));

pool.anchor.set(0.5); pool.position.set(ax, ay + grid * 0.45);

pool.width = 0; pool.height = 0;

layer.addChild(pool);

const rim = new PIXI.Sprite(oni.radialTexture(cfg.rimColor, 'rgba(0,0,0,0)', { size: 256 }));

rim.anchor.set(0.5, 1.0); rim.blendMode = PIXI.BLEND_MODES.ADD;

rim.position.set(ax, ay + grid * 0.5);

rim.width = grid * cfg.shadeWCells * 1.2; rim.height = 0; rim.alpha = 0.0;

layer.addChild(rim);

const shade = new PIXI.Sprite(oni.radialTexture(cfg.shadeColor, 'rgba(0,0,0,0)', { size: 256 }));

shade.anchor.set(0.5, 1.0); // bottom-centre

shade.position.set(ax, ay + grid * 0.5);

shade.width = grid * cfg.shadeWCells; shade.height = 0;

layer.addChild(shade);

const motes = [];

for (let i = 0; i < cfg.riseMotes; i++) {

const m = new PIXI.Sprite(oni.radialTexture(cfg.rimColor, 'rgba(0,0,0,0)', { size: 48 }));

m.anchor.set(0.5); m.blendMode = PIXI.BLEND_MODES.ADD;

m.width = m.height = 8 + Math.random() * 16;

m._x = ax + (Math.random() - 0.5) * grid * cfg.shadeWCells;

m._y0 = ay + grid * 0.4;

m._h = grid * cfg.shadeHCells * (0.5 + Math.random() * 0.7);

m._delay = Math.random() * 0.5;

m.position.set(m._x, m._y0); m.alpha = 0;

layer.addChild(m); motes.push(m);

}

oni.sfx(cfg.riseSfx, { volume: cfg.volume });

let fired = false;

await oni.tween({

from: 0, to: 1, duration: cfg.riseMs, ease: oni.EASE.outCubic,

onUpdate: (v) => {

pool.width = grid * cfg.poolWCells * Math.min(1, v * 1.6);

pool.height = grid * cfg.poolWCells * 0.45 * Math.min(1, v * 1.6);

pool.alpha = Math.min(1, v * 2);

shade.height = grid * cfg.shadeHCells * v;

rim.height = grid * cfg.shadeHCells * v; rim.alpha = Math.sin(v * Math.PI) * 0.6;

for (const m of motes) {

const t = Math.max(0, (v - m._delay) / (1 - m._delay));

m.position.set(m._x, m._y0 - m._h * t);

m.alpha = Math.sin(Math.min(1, t) * Math.PI) * 0.9;

}

if (!fired && v >= 0.85) { fired = true; oni.fireDone(); }

},

});

if (!fired) oni.fireDone();

// Undim; the real summoned token takes over at this spot.

await dim.fadeOut({ duration: cfg.dimOutMs });

await oni.tween({

from: 1, to: 0, duration: cfg.settleMs, ease: oni.EASE.inQuad,

onUpdate: (v) => { shade.alpha = v; pool.alpha = v; rim.alpha = v * 0.5; for (const m of motes) m.alpha = v * 0.5; },

});

`;

game.ONI.pseudo.play({

scriptId: "geist/living-shadow",

scriptSource,

casterTokenUuid: casterUuid,

targetTokenUuids: [],

params: { doneHook, cfg: CFG },

});

await onceHook(doneHook, CFG.sacHold + CFG.dimInMs + CFG.riseMs + CFG.dimOutMs + CFG.settleMs + 7000);

Hooks.callAll("oni:animationEnd", { local: true, world: false });

})();

props.animation_script:
// @desc Geist — Souleater: dim, impact + shake on target, drain soul to caster (oni)

"use strict";

(async () => {

const CFG = {

dimTo: 0.6,

dimInMs: 260,

dimOutMs: 320,

castSfx: "https://assets.forge-vtt.com/610d918102e7ac281373ffcb/Sound/Soundboard/Darkness4.ogg",

volume: 0.85,

impactColor: "rgba(150,60,230,0.95)",

impactSize: 240,

impactMs: 300,

shakeMs: 460,

shakeAmp: 12, // px jitter of the target clone

soulColor: "rgba(180,90,255,0.95)",

soulSize: 70,

drainMs: 620, // target -> caster travel of the soul

};

const P = payload ?? globalThis.__PAYLOAD ?? {};

const casterUuid = P.casterTokenUuid ?? P.sourceTokenUuid ?? null;

const targetUuids = (P.targetTokenUuids ?? (P.targets ?? []).map((t) => t.tokenUuid) ?? []).filter(Boolean);

const doneHook = "oni:done:" + foundry.utils.randomID(8);

const onceHook = (name, ms) => new Promise((resolve) => {

const id = Hooks.once(name, () => { clearTimeout(t); resolve(); });

const t = setTimeout(() => { Hooks.off(name, id); resolve(); }, ms);

});

Hooks.callAll("oni:animationStart", { local: true, world: false });

const scriptSource = String.raw`

const cfg = ctx.params.cfg;

const caster = oni.caster;

const target = oni.targets[0] || null;

if (!caster || !target) { oni.fireDone(); return; }

const dim = await oni.dim({ to: cfg.dimTo, fadeIn: cfg.dimInMs });

oni.sfx(cfg.castSfx, { volume: cfg.volume });

const layer = oni.layer({ zIndex: 95000 });

const tx = target.center.x, ty = target.center.y;

const cx = caster.center.x, cy = caster.center.y;

// Impact burst on the target.

const burst = new PIXI.Sprite(oni.radialTexture(cfg.impactColor, 'rgba(0,0,0,0)', { size: 256 }));

burst.anchor.set(0.5);

burst.blendMode = PIXI.BLEND_MODES.ADD;

burst.position.set(tx, ty);

layer.addChild(burst);

// Clone the target and jitter it (localized token shake), hide the real one.

const tClone = oni.cloneToken(target, { parent: layer });

const tRestore = oni.hideToken(target);

await Promise.all([

oni.tween({

from: 0, to: 1, duration: cfg.impactMs, ease: oni.EASE.outCubic,

onUpdate: (v) => { burst.width = burst.height = cfg.impactSize * v; burst.alpha = 1 - v; },

}),

oni.tween({

from: 0, to: 1, duration: cfg.shakeMs, ease: oni.EASE.linear,

onUpdate: (v) => {

if (!tClone) return;

const a = cfg.shakeAmp * (1 - v);

tClone.position.set(tx + (Math.random() - 0.5) * 2 * a, ty + (Math.random() - 0.5) * 2 * a);

},

}),

]);

if (tClone) tClone.position.set(tx, ty);

// The soul (a purple mote) tears free and is drawn back into the caster.

const soul = new PIXI.Sprite(oni.radialTexture(cfg.soulColor, 'rgba(0,0,0,0)', { size: 128 }));

soul.anchor.set(0.5);

soul.blendMode = PIXI.BLEND_MODES.ADD;

soul.width = soul.height = cfg.soulSize;

soul.position.set(tx, ty);

layer.addChild(soul);

await oni.tween({

from: 0, to: 1, duration: cfg.drainMs, ease: oni.EASE.inCubic,

onUpdate: (v) => {

soul.position.set(tx + (cx - tx) * v, ty + (cy - ty) * v);

soul.width = soul.height = cfg.soulSize * (1 - 0.5 * v);

},

});

tRestore();

await dim.fadeOut({ duration: cfg.dimOutMs });

// Gate damage AFTER the full drain + undim, so BD's RESOLVE HP-recompute

// stall lands after the visual rather than freezing the sequence's tail.

oni.fireDone();

`;

game.ONI.pseudo.play({

scriptId: "geist/souleater",

scriptSource,

casterTokenUuid: casterUuid,

targetTokenUuids: targetUuids,

params: { doneHook, cfg: CFG },

});

await onceHook(doneHook, CFG.dimInMs + CFG.impactMs + CFG.shakeMs + CFG.drainMs + 6000);

Hooks.callAll("oni:animationEnd", { local: true, world: false });

})();

props.skill_information:
Trigger: When Geist is reduced to 0 HP while his Zero Power is full (6).

Effect: Geist expends all of his Zero Power and sacrifices part of his soul. His lesser shadows collapse — and he rises again: HP is restored up to a waning threshold (70% of max, then 70% of the previous threshold each time this triggers) and MP is fully restored. His maximum HP is unchanged.

If his Zero Power is not full when he falls, the darkness fails him — Geist is destroyed for good, and his shadows die with him.
